description.value: The Dayton Audio MX6-22 subwoofer packs impressive performance into a compact 6-1/2" frame, allowing surprisingly deep and powerful bass from places where larger subs simply won't fit. Its long-throw design, vented architecture, and distortion-taming aluminum shorting sleeve keep the low end tight, clean, and powerful whether you drop it into a home build or a car audio project. Its modern, seamless look fits any setup, and the robust build stands strong during demanding low-frequency bursts. Thanks to its dual 2-ohm voice coils, the MX6-22 can be compatible with most amplifiers and brings full, satisfying bass to a wide range of installations. Quick Overview Product Highlights Long-throw motor and low resonance frequency deliver powerful low-frequency output from compact enclosures Full-coverage concave dust cap reinforces the paper cone and creates a clean modern appearance Aluminum shorting sleeve stabilizes inductance for lower distortion across the operating range Vented frame, vented pole piece, and gap vents improve airflow to reduce heat buildup and compression Surround profile covers the frame for a seamless look and increased adhesive bonding area Precision-tooled steel frame provides the structural clearance needed for high travel limits Dual 2-ohm voice coils allow flexible wiring options for optimal amplifier loading

model.value: MX6-22 6-1/2" Max-X High Excursion DVC Subwoofer Driver 2 Ohms Per Coil
